item.text:
The replacement was motivated by these constraints and requirements:

- Large MCP servers currently load all tools, which hurts performance.
- Users often only need a small subset of tools, so loading everything adds unnecessary complexity and cognitive load.
- There was no client-side way to restrict access to sensitive tools on a per-project basis.
- Server-side customization is not always possible, especially for packaged servers.
- The intended fix had to be client-side only, with no MCP protocol or server changes.
- The replacement also needed to support per-project configuration and simple selective enable/disable of individual tools.

Source: [GitHub issue #7328, “MCP Tool Filtering”](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/7328)
